dissolved_oxygen_low: Low dissolved oxygen stresses fish and shrimp and can cause losses if it keeps falling. It often drops overnight and in warm weather.
ph_low: Low pH (acidic water) can stress stock and change how harmful substances in the water behave.
ph_high: High pH can stress stock, and it makes ammonia more harmful.
temperature_high: Warm water holds less oxygen and raises the oxygen the stock needs.
temperature_low: Cold water slows feeding and growth and can stress stock.
